use_cases: Display animated headlines with staggered character effects on landing pages
Create eye-catching follower count displays for social media profiles
Add playful animated typography to hero sections
Build animated call-to-action text with continuous motion effects
Design dynamic text displays with layered font styles for branding
ai_summary: An animated text component that renders characters with staggered CSS animations (font skew and scale) creating a playful, eye-catching display. The animation runs continuously with character-specific delays calculated based on position, supports dark/light modes, and uses distinctive Londrina Google Fonts for visual impact. Features layered text rendering with shadow effects and responsive spacing.
